# ZE-443 local TCK-style fixtures; these are not original TCK coordinates.
=== ZE-443 [1] Boolean combinations and anonymous label constraints
setup
      CREATE (a:A {id:1}), (b:A {id:2}), (a)-[:T]->(:B)
query
      MATCH (a:A)
      WHERE (a)-[:T]->(:B) OR (a.id = 2 AND NOT exists((a)-[:T]->()))
      RETURN a.id
      ORDER BY a.id
expect ordered
      | a.id |
      | 1    |
      | 2    |
side-effects none

=== ZE-443 [2] Null correlation and anonymous variables do not escape
setup
      CREATE (:A)-[:T]->(:B)
query
      OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Missing)
      WITH a, exists((a)-[:T]->()) AS found
      RETURN found, NOT found
expect bag
      | found | NOT found |
      | false | true      |
side-effects none
